response.sql: SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) as avg_alp, AVG(l.HCT) as avg_hct FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-') AND l.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_hct IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_hct DESC LIMIT 10;
